laws.rule: Fukui City bans smoking on the street on the west and east plazas of Fukui Station and the area around them, and bans dropping cans or cigarette butts and leaving pet droppings anywhere in the city. Smokers in the zone are asked to use the public smoking area; since 2 March 2023 an indoor public smoking room sits beside the public toilets under the elevated station tracks (open 5 am to 1 am). The city's page states no fine amount.
